column1:
The sea areas off the coast extending from Kankasanthurai to Hambantota via Trincomalee and Pottuvil will
be rough to very rough at times.
The sea areas off the coast extending from Beruwala to Kankasanthurai via Colombo and Puttalam will be
rough at times.
The other sea areas around the island may be moderate.
The wave height may increase (about 2.5 – 3.0 m) in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Kankasanthurai to Pottuvil via Trincomalee (this is not for land area).
